title: FairAIED: Navigating Fairness, Bias, and Ethics in Educational AI Applications
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not analyze aspects of religion. It is a survey paper on fairness in educational AI and does not conduct its own benchmarking.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it is not a subject of its analysis. The focus is on fairness related to other demographic attributes such as race, gender, socioeconomic status, and linguistic background in educational contexts.
